issue.title: Rotten Log: a dated, reasoned history of every rotten keep
issue.description: Every counted keep of a rotten task (Alt+F or Ctrl+Alt+F on an exact due Ready ROTTEN or scheduled TICKLER row, and Keep on the approved-decay card) asks "Why keep it as written?" and, in the same transaction as the stamp, writes one dated entry under a `🥀 **ROTTEN LOG**` child. Each task then shows how many times, when, and why it was kept: in the note, in the prompt, on the decay card, on the freshness mark tooltip, in note snapshots, and in the Mac agenda.
